description_en: Queries the summary of cloud service configuration check results, including the number of risk items, risk rate, number of affected assets, check time, and statistics by type
description_zh: 查看云产品配置检查结果汇总信息，包括风险项数量、风险率、影响资产数量、检测时间以及各个类型统计数据等
name: DescribeRiskCheckSummary

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的访问源的IP地址
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member account in the resource directory for multi-account security management
parameters.help_zh: 多账号安全管控的成员账户的AliUid
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RiskCheckSummary.description_en: The statistics of cloud service configuration check results
RiskCheckSummary.description_zh: 云产品配置检查的结果统计

AffectedAssetCount.description_en: The number of assets affected by risk items in the check results
AffectedAssetCount.description_zh: 检查结果中风险项影响的资产数量

DisabledRiskCount.description_en: The number of check items that failed the check
DisabledRiskCount.description_zh: 检查不通过的检查项数量

EnabledRiskCount.description_en: The number of check items that passed the check
EnabledRiskCount.description_zh: 检查通过的检查项数量

Groups.description_en: The statistics information list by check item type
Groups.description_zh: 检查项类型的统计信息列表

items.description_en: The statistics information of a check item type
items.description_zh: 检查项类型的统计信息

CountByStatus.description_en: The list of check item result statistics

Count.description_en: The number of detected risk items

Status.description_en:
The status of the check item after the check is complete. Valid values:

pass: The check item passed the check, which indicates that the check item is normal.

failed: The check item failed the check, which indicates that the check item has risks
Status.description_zh:
完成检查后，检查项的状态。取值：

pass：检查通过，表示检查项正常。

failed：检查不通过，表示检查项存在风险

Id.description_en: The ID of the check item category

Sort.description_en: The sort order of the check item type in the All Types drop-down list in the console
Sort.description_zh: 检查项类型在控制台全部类型下拉列表中的排列顺序

Status.description_en:
The check status. Valid values:

finish: The check is complete.

running: The check is in progress.

waiting: The check is waiting.

notStart: The check has not started
Status.description_zh:
检查完成的状态。取值：

finish：检查已完成

running：检查中

waiting：检查等待中

notStart：检查未开始

Title.description_en: The name of the check item category

PreviousCount.description_en: The number of risk items detected in the previous check
PreviousCount.description_zh: 上次检查到的风险项数量

PreviousTime.description_en: The timestamp of the previous check. Unit: milliseconds
PreviousTime.description_zh: 上次检查的时间戳。单位：毫秒

RiskCount.description_en: The number of detected risk items

RiskLevelCount.description_en: The list of check item counts by risk level
RiskLevelCount.description_zh: 检查项每类危险等级的数量列表

items.description_en: The count of check items for each risk level
items.description_zh: 检查项每类危险等级的数量

Count.description_en: The number of check items at the specified risk level
Count.description_zh: 检查项的危险等级的数量

Key.description_en:
The risk level of the check item. Valid values:
high: high risk
medium: medium risk
low: low risk
Key.description_zh:
检查项的危险等级。取值：
high：高危
medium：中危
low：低危

RiskRate.description_en: The percentage of detected risk items in the total number of check items
RiskRate.description_zh: 检查出的风险项数量在检查项总数中所占的百分比
